# CANDIDATE: TV-Data-Stale-Fixer

**Filed:** 2026-07-04
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger_branch
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The TV data stale issue causes the engine to miss trades due to outdated levels and trendlines. A fixer mechanism can be implemented to update the levels and trendlines in real-time, improving the engine's performance.

## Mechanism

The fixer mechanism will utilize the `mcp__tradingview__tv_health_check` function to verify the TV connection and update the levels and trendlines every 5 minutes. If the TV connection is lost, the mechanism will attempt to reconnect and update the levels and trendlines.
